sections.instructions: Conjuga los verbos entre paréntesis en pretérito indefinido.

items.prompt: Ayer Marta y Luis (perder) ___ el autobús.
items.english: Yesterday Marta and Luis missed the bus.

items.prompt: Hace cinco años (ganar/yo) ___ en el bingo.
items.english: Five years ago I won at bingo.

items.prompt: Ni Paco ni tú (salir) ___ a la ceremonia.
items.english: Neither Paco nor you went out to the ceremony.
items.note: Compound subject (Paco + tú) takes vosotros form in Spain register; Latin America would use 'salieron' addressing a plural group contextually, but grammatically this pairing is 2nd-person plural informal.

items.prompt: Alex y yo (mover) ___ todos los muebles de sitio.
items.english: Alex and I moved all the furniture around.

sections.instructions: Conjuga los verbos entre paréntesis en pretérito indefinido.

items.prompt: Raquel y Vicente (tener) ___ que cancelar sus vacaciones.
items.english: Raquel and Vicente had to cancel their vacation.

items.prompt: (andar/yo) ___ por la sombra porque hacía mucho calor.
items.english: I walked in the shade because it was very hot.
items.irregular_group: estar/tener/poder (uv stem) — andar behaves like estar: anduv-

items.prompt: Lo que Manuela y tú (hacer) ___ es imperdonable.
items.english: What Manuela and you did is unforgivable.
items.note: vosotros form; hiciste would be tú singular

items.english: Didn't you bring anything to the party?
items.irregular_group: j-stem irregular (traje, trajiste, trajo, trajimos, trajeron)
items.note: New irregular pattern: traer → traj-; note NO 'i' in ellos form (trajeron, not trajieron)

items.english: We never found out the truth.
items.note: saber in preterite often means 'found out' rather than 'knew'

sections.instructions: Conjuga los verbos entre paréntesis en pretérito indefinido.

items.prompt: El taxista (dar) ___ una gran vuelta en lugar de ir directamente al hotel.
items.english: The taxi driver took a long way around instead of going straight to the hotel.
Last week I was on sick leave.

items.prompt: El año pasado, todos los alumnos (aprobar) ___ los exámenes finales.
items.english: Last year, all the students passed their final exams.
The artist asked the audience for silence.
items.irregular_group: e→i stem change (3rd person only in preterite)

items.english: Last night the children fell asleep right away.
items.irregular_group: o→u stem change (3rd person only in preterite)

new_irregular_pattern_introduced.note: J-stem verbs (traer, decir, conducir, traducir) drop the 'i' in the ellos/ustedes ending: trajeron NOT trajieron; dijeron NOT dijieron
